headline: DSK Legal, IC RegFin Legal, Sarvaank Associates act on first institutional fundraise of MOI SOI
sum: Packaged Food & Beverages brand MOI SOI, owned and operated by Ceres Foods Private Limited, has secured investments from GVFL Emerging Enterprise Venture Trust and Wipro Consumer Care Ventures in its first institutional fundraise. DSK…
detail: Packaged Food & Beverages brand MOI SOI, owned and operated by Ceres Foods Private Limited, has secured investments from GVFL Emerging Enterprise Venture Trust and Wipro Consumer Care Ventures in its first institutional fundraise. DSK Legal advised Ceres Foods and founder Deb Mukherjee on this fundraise. Aparajit Bhattacharya (Partner) acted as the relationship Partner and the lead engagement Partner. The transaction team consisted of Harvinder Singh (Partner), Manhar Gulani (Principal Associate), Mala Mehto (Principal Associate), Associates Brijesh Ranjan Sahoo and Sumedha Tewari.
